headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo threw for 317 yards and four touchdowns and the San Francisco 49ers reach the halfway point of their season undefeated, beating the Arizona Cardinals 28-25 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garoppolo throws 4 TD passes, 49ers beat Cardinals 28-25

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson's most impressive throw Sunday went backward -- a flip under pressure to running back Carlos Hyde, whose 7-yard gain set up Houston's first TD in a 26-3 runaway over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: No looking back: Watson on point as Texans top Jags 26-3

headlines.description: Rookie Devin Singletary had 95 yards rushing, including a 2-yard touchdown, and the Buffalo Bills are off to their best start since 1993 following a 24-9 win over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buffalo Bills outrun Washington in 24-9 victory, move to 6-2

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Harrison Butker matched a career long with a 54-yard field goal to tie the game late in the fourth quarter, then drilled a 44-yarder as time expired to give the Kansas City Chiefs a thrilling 26-23 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butker's late FGs help Chiefs rally past Vikings, 26-23

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw three touchdown passes, two of them to rookie Preston Williams, and the Miami Dolphins got their first win of the season by beating former coach Adam Gase and the New York Jets 26-18 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins get first win of 2019, top Jets 26-18

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw for 239 yards and one touchdown, Jordan Howard ran for 82 yards and a score and the Philadelphia Eagles held on for a 22-14 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz, Howard lead Eagles past Bears 22-14
Vinatieri misses late, Steelers edge Colts 26-24

headlines.description: Christian McCaffrey had 166 yards from scrimmage and scored three touchdowns, and the Carolina Panthers bounced back from an embarrassing defeat with a 30-20 victory over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey scores 3 TDs as Panthers defeat Titans 30-20

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a 9-yard touchdown pass to rookie Hunter Renfrow with 2:04 remaining and Karl Joseph broke up a fourth-down pass in the end zone with 3 seconds left to give the Raiders a 31-24 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday in their first...
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders get late TD pass, defensive stop to beat Lions 31-24

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson hit Jacob Hollister on a 10-yard touchdown on the opening possession of overtime, and the Seattle Seahawks rallied for a 40-34 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 5 TDs, Seahawks outlast Bucs 40-34 in OT

headlines.description: Fourth-year quarterback Brandon Allen sparked Denver's stagnant offense, throwing for two touchdowns in his first career NFL start and leading the Broncos past the stumbling Cleveland Browns 24-19 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen leads Broncos past Browns 24-19 in first NFL start

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Melvin Gordon scored two touchdowns, Michael Badgley kicked four field goals and the Los Angeles Chargers dominated the Green Bay Packers 26-11 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gordon scores twice as Chargers dominate Packers 26-11

events.name: New England Patriots at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: The New England Patriots' unbeaten season crashed to an end under the weight of their own mistakes and inability to contain Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson, who ripped apart the NFL's stingiest defense with his arm and legs in a 37-20...
headlines.shortLinkText: Unbeaten no more, Patriots fall to Jackson and Ravens 37-20

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Dak Prescott shook off an interception on his first pass of the game and threw three touchdown passes, leading the Dallas Cowboys to a 37-18 victory over the New York Giants in a Monday night game briefly delayed by an elusive black cat.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws for 3 TDs as Cowboys beat Giants again
